_about: Recorded answers of the analysis bot for the self-test fixture tests/fixtures/analysis-project: one call per step, in plan order. The main model uses ds.glmSLMA, which DSLite can't run (settings dslite_untestable).

sections.purpose: Keep the complete cases of outcome, exposure and confounder
Mean BMI per study and pooled
sections.code:
bmi_mean <- ds.mean(x = "D_cc$PM_BMI_CONTINUOUS", type = "both", datasources = conns)
print(bmi_mean$Mean.by.Study)

model_pooled <- ds.glm(formula = "DIS_DIAB ~ PM_BMI_CONTINUOUS + GENDER", data = "D_cc", family = "binomial", datasources = conns)
print(model_pooled$coefficients)

model_slma <- ds.glmSLMA(formula = "DIS_DIAB ~ PM_BMI_CONTINUOUS + GENDER", family = "binomial", dataName = "D_cc", datasources = conns)
print(model_slma$SLMA.pooled.ests.matrix)
